## TickLib.tickToApr() function

Converts a Midnight tick into a WAD simple annual percentage rate.

This is an SDK-only rate display convenience. It annualizes the fixed period rate from  over `timeToMaturity` seconds.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function tickToApr(tick: BigIntish, timeToMaturity: BigIntish): bigint;
```

**Returns:**

bigint

WAD simple APR rounded up.

## Exceptions

`NegativeValueError` when `tick` or `timeToMaturity` is negative.

`TickOutOfRangeError` when `tick` exceeds `MAX_TICK`<!-- -->.

`DivisionByZeroError` when the tick price or `timeToMaturity` is zero.

## Example


```ts
import { TickLib } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";
import { Time } from "@morpho-org/morpho-ts";

const apr = TickLib.tickToApr(6744n, Time.s.from.y(1n));
console.log(apr);
```
